\documentclass[tikz,border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning, shapes.geometric, arrows.meta,
                fit, backgrounds, calc}

% Flowchart styles, shared by every picture in this document.
\tikzset{
  base/.style   = {draw, minimum width=2.6cm, minimum height=9mm, align=center},
  process/.style  = {base, rectangle, fill=blue!8},
  decision/.style = {base, diamond, aspect=2, fill=orange!15, inner sep=1pt},
  terminal/.style = {base, rounded rectangle, fill=green!10},
  io/.style       = {base, trapezium, trapezium left angle=70,
                     trapezium right angle=110, fill=gray!10},
  every edge/.style = {draw, -{Stealth[length=2.5mm]}},
}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[node distance=8mm and 14mm, font=\small]
  \node[terminal]                 (start)  {Start};
  \node[io, below=of start]       (read)   {Read $n$};
  \node[decision, below=of read]  (check)  {$n \le 1$?};
  \node[process, right=of check]  (base)   {Return $1$};
  \node[process, below=of check]  (rec)    {Compute\\ $n \cdot f(n-1)$};
  \node[terminal, below=of rec]   (stop)   {Stop};

  \draw[-{Stealth}] (start) -- node[right] {yes} (read);
  \draw[-{Stealth}] (read)  -- (check);
  \draw[-{Stealth}] (check) -- node[above] {yes} (base);
  \draw[-{Stealth}] (check) -- node[right] {no}  (rec);
  \draw[-{Stealth}] (rec)   -- (stop);
  \draw[-{Stealth}] (base)  |- (stop);   % orthogonal return path

  \begin{scope}[on background layer]
    \node[draw=gray, dashed, rounded corners, fit=(check) (base) (rec),
          inner sep=3mm, label={[gray]above left:recursion}] (box) {};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
